overview:
**Fire danger is Moderate today, driven by dry fuels and a dry, mild week with no rain in sight.**
- Danger holds Moderate through Oct 8, but Stage 1 fire restrictions remain in effect on BLM lands across Montrose, Delta, Mesa, Gunnison, Ouray, San Miguel, Hinsdale, Saguache, and San Juan counties, running through Dec. 31 unless rescinded.
- Energy Release and Burning Index percentiles climb steadily this week, from 52%/54% today toward 66%/60% by Oct 8, as fuels keep drying.
- Sunny, mild weather dominates: high near 72 today, low around 38 tonight, and 76 Saturday, with no measurable precipitation forecast all week.
- No Red Flag Warning is posted, and 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are met today.
- Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forests rescinded Stage 1 restrictions beginning Sept. 3, citing improved moisture, though BLM Stage 1 rules still apply.
- No active wildfires are listed near this area in today's national incident situation report.
lead: Fire danger is Moderate today, driven by dry fuels and a dry, mild week with no rain in sight.
